content: Timoteya yota ni Paulusi ni Sailasi
Paulusi sebeli wiiya mu Deba ni ku Lisitila. Omo kame ku na kwikalanga omwiyetwa, no litina lya Timoteya. Omwana no mukati no Mujuda omuasikupumena, kono sitaye neli omungelike
Kame ana kupakiwa wino kwaa asikupumena na mu Lisitila ni mu Ikoniyamu,
Paulusi kame ana ku saela Timoteya nji amu sindekete, mi sebeli omushimba ni ku mubeeka ku mupato mulibaka no Majuda ana kwiikalanga mu ibaka eyo, kakuli kame ana kulimuka nji sitaye neli mungelike
Aali mu musipili woo okuta ku milenen̄i, sebeli alaela aaasikupumena nji amamele omulawo ana kubeeka atumiwa naakulu awo ana kwikalnga mu Jelusalema.
Cwale etikeleke kame tina kongotiwa mu tumelo, ni kwekeza ku palo mu liywaa ni liywaa.
Epono ya Paulusi no mulume naku Mesodoniya
Cwale sebeli ata mu naha no Filinjiya ni mu Galatiya, kakuli Emebo No Kukena kame ina kwaakanisa okwamba amaywi mu Asia.
Cwale aba ana kwiiya okusheeteta amabapa ni Misiya, sebeli a saela okuta mu Betiniya, kono Emebo ya Jesu kaisikwa alumelela.
Cwale aba ana kumana okweenda mu naha no Misiya, sebeli ashetumukela ku Tulowasi.
Paulusi sebeli omona epono mu usiku, omulume naku Mesodoniya yo imanine yo mu kumbela ni kwamba nji, “Wiiye mu Mesodoniya mukututusa.”
Cwale aba ana kumana okumona epono eyo, Ababo sebeli tuku tukiseta mu wangu okuta ku Mesodoniya, me tunahana nji Nyambe kame ana twisanene oka kutazamo eliywi kwa onyene.
Mu Filipi, Okufutuka kwa Lidiya
Aba tuna kufuula okutunda mu Tulowasi, sebeli tuta ku Samotilasi, eliywaa lina kutatamako sebeli tukafuweka mu Ne-yapolisi.
Aba tuna kutundamo sebeli tukaingena mu Filipi, omulenen̄i no weli mu sikiliti no Mesodoniya, kame ni koloni no Maloma. Sebeli twiikalamo amaywaa no mupula.
Cwale ba liywaa no Pumulo sebeli tuta ku nyonga no musindi, oko tuna kuhupula nji kame kuli esibaka no milapelo, mi sebeli twiikala ni kwamba naakati ana ku unganako.

Omukati omunjili mwa onyene ona kutuyupa neli no litina lya Lidiya, ona kutunda mu mulenen̄i no Tiyatila, omuulisi no ibyana no undilu. Woyo olapela Nyambe, mi Ombumu sebeli oyatulula omucima waye nji atokomele eyo aamba Paulusi.
Cwale aba ana kumana okukolobeziwa, naasindoo yaye, sebeli otu kumbela nji, “Nji namwaatula nji mbili wa ku sepahala kwa Mbumu, mwiiye mu ndoo yange mwikalemo.” Sebeli otu hapeleza okuta.
Mu Tolongo ku Filipi
Eliywaa linjili kame tuna tanga mu sibaka no milapelo, sebeli tukuwana ni musizana no mubika woyo oli ni mebo no unuhi, naku fumisa onene molyaye mu ku nuha.
Sebeli okon̄a Paulusi naaci yo kuweleza nji, “Alume aa nabika a Nyambe oli beulu! Kame amyambela endila no mooyo!”

Eyi kame ana kwitenda mu maywaa no kupula. Kono Paulusi sebeli otina, ni ku futuka ni kwamba ku mebo nji, “Kame ni ku laela mu litina lya Jesu Kilesite otunde mwa yonyene!” Cwale sebeli itunda mwa yonyene ababo ba nako eyeyo.
Kono aolyaye aba ana kumona nji naabwelwe esepo no ku fuma, sebeli alema Paulusi ni Sailasi ni kwatwala mu sibaka no musika balubala nwaa busisi.
Cwale aba ana kumana okwaalita bouso nwaatuli, sebeli aamba nji, “Alume aa, Majuda mi kame alyanganisa omulenen̄i wetu.
Kame aiyeta emikwa eyo no kwafanena nji twiikon̄e ni kwiitambula aaci Amaloma.”
Enyangela sebeli itateka okwaalwisa, mi aatuli sebeli akaola eikumango yoo ni kuba etaelo nji afuliwe ni pafa.
Cwale aba ana kumana okwafula emiupa no kupula, sebeli aaingenyeka mu tolongo, ni ku laela omutateleli nji aatatelele onene.
Woyo aba na laelelwe ngeeso, sebeli waabeeka mu tolongo na mukaci ni kwaabeeka amakondo oo mu itondo.
Kono ba kaci no usiku Paulusi ni Sailasi sebeli alapela ni kwiimba etindimo kwa Nyambe, mi amapantiti ateeteta.
Mu nako imweya fela sebeli kwiiya ezikinyeho no litunga, cwale emitomo no tolongo sebeli inyanganya mi ababo emyelo sebeli iyatuluka mi amawenge onje sebeli anungutuka ku munu yonje.
Cwale omutateleli aba ana kwinguka ni kumona nji emyelo naiyatuluka, sebeli oshomona omukwale waye nji akwibae, ba kuhupula nji mwendi amapantiti onje naatundumo.
Kono Paulusi sebeli okuwa ni liywi no kuneneba nji, “Olese okwibaa, kakuli tusilimo toonje.”
Omutateleli aba ana ku kumbela elibona, sebeli witukelamo, mu kucila sebeli okakwela ku makondo a Paulusi ni Sailasi.
Cwale sebeli waatundiseta ba ndee ni kwamba nji, “Alume, ngasibine sani tende nji ni yoyisiwe?”
Cwale sebeli aamba nji, “Olumele mwa Mbumu Jesu, mbuyoyisiwa, wene mane naasindoo yowe.”
Cwale sebeli aamba amaywi no Mbumu kwa yonyene ni kwao onje ana kwikala mu ndoo yaye.
Sebeli waashimba mu nako eyeyo no usiku, ni kwaayowisa ba miupa-upa yoo, mi sebeli okolobeziwa ababo naasindoo yaye onje.
Cwale sebeli waalita mu ndoo yaye, ni kwaaba eilya balubala woo, ni ku wabelelwa naa sindoo yaya onje kakuli na lumele mwa Nyambe.
Kono aba kuna kupa, aatuli sebeli alaela omupolisa, ni kwamba nji, “Waalukulule awo alume akutele.”
Cwale omupolisa sebeli osimweta Paulusi amaywi awo, ni kwamba nji, “Aatuli nani tumu nji mu lukululwe mu kutele. Cwalehe na mulukululwa, mi mweende mu kozo.”

Kono Paulusi sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Kame ana tufulu balubala nwaanu, kono kasikutwatula oweli, aci tutendile tuli amaloma, mi naatubeeke mu tolongo. Cwale kame asaela oku tu tundisamo ku mukunda? Kokuulwa! Mwaalesele onyene aiye muku tutundisamo.”
Amapolisa sebeli asimweta aatuli amaywi ao, mi sebeli acila aba ana kuyupa nji neli Maloma.
Cwale sebeli aiya nuuku kokobeza kwaonyene. Sebeli aatundisamo, ni kwakumbela nji asiye omulenen̄i.
Cwale aba ana kutunda mu tolongo, sebeli ata kwa Lidiya, mi cwale aba ana kumana okumona naaasikupumena, ni kwaaongota emicima, mi sebeli afunduka.
